title: Simvastatin in Preventing Liver Cancer in Patients With Liver Cirrhosis

sections.abstract:
This phase II trial studies how well simvastatin works in preventing liver cancer in patients with liver cirrhosis. Simvastatin may stop the growth of cancer cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

Posted outcomes: Change in Serum AFP-L3%. timeframe=Baseline to 6 months. Group I (Simvastatin)=0.24 (±1.00); Group II (Placebo)=-0.04 (±0.11)
